newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka-Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka-Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

COLOMBO, Oct 14 - Nine container dischargers, two fertiliser dischargers, one cement discharger, one steel discharger, one LPG discharger, one palm oil discharger, four general cargo loaders and one container loader presently working in port. One fertiliser, three food dischargers, one steel and four container vessels awaiting berths.
